profile.summary: Wikunia is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, focusing on core visualization logic, axis scaling, and UI/UX enhancements. Their contributions demonstrate deep problem-solving skills for data visualization challenges, including logarithmic scales, negative value rendering, and multi-axis charts. While primarily frontend-focused, their work aligns with a frontend visualization engineer or data visualization specialist. Evidence suggests strong collaboration in open-source contributions, with a focus on readability and performance.
